codeReview.summary: Reviewed feature scope against description and expectedBehavior. The commit provides the requested Spring Boot 4.0 backend scaffold: required starters/dependencies, application bootstrap class, profile-based application.yml, Flyway migrations V1-V5 plus V100 seed, 5 JPA entities, repository interfaces, FakeAuthFilter with X-User-Id/default user behavior, permit-all SecurityConfig with localhost:5173 CORS, /api/health endpoint, docker-compose PostgreSQL 18, and baseline integration test for context + health 200.
